name: reelsy-video
description: Create Canvas-visible Reelsy videos and owner-scoped vocal or instrumental music, then let Codex complete the requested editing workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit Reelsy videos from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to owner-scoped Reelsy projects through the production OAuth MCP. Reelsy performs paid video and music generation with explicit cost confirmation, including vocal-song generation and source-audio song rewriting. Codex remains responsible for source analysis, lyric rewriting, captions, and final editing. OpenCut browser exports remain local and do not create Canvas Final Artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Generate a Reelsy video with the fewest valid clips
Rewrite the song in my video with new approved lyrics
Edit my Reelsy timeline with captions and visual layers
